slides.body: Palo Alto Networks has released security updates for a high-severity vulnerability in its PAN-OS software. This flaw, identified as a remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the management interface, poses a significant risk. Crucially, the company confirms that this vulnerability is already under active exploitation by attackers. Users are urged to apply the security updates immediately to protect their systems from potential compromise.
